Cache miss. Fetch from disk. Write back. Done.

The service starts in 40 ms. It binds port 8080. It reads config from env. No retries on boot.

Latency: p50 is 12 ms. p99 is 90 ms. Tail spikes come from GC. We pin the heap to 512 MB. Spikes drop.

Queue depth stays flat. Workers pull one job at a time. Each job has a timeout. Timeouts kill the worker. The supervisor restarts it.

Config: three keys only. PORT, DB_URL, LOG_LEVEL. Defaults are sane. Override per host.

Deploy: build, test, push. The pipeline takes six minutes. Rollback takes one. We roll back first and debug after.

Index the user table on email. Query time falls from 300 ms to 2 ms. Writes slow by 3 percent. Accept it.

Logs are JSON. One line per event. Fields: ts, level, msg, trace. Grep works. So does jq.

Disk fills at 2 GB per day. Rotate hourly. Keep seven days. Delete the rest.

The parser rejects bad input. It returns code 400. It never panics. Fuzzing found four bugs. All four are fixed.

Locks: take them in order. Release them in reverse. Never hold one across a network call. This rule ended the deadlocks.

Metrics: count requests, errors, retries. Alert on error rate above 1 percent. Page on two windows in a row.

Build the image once. Run it everywhere. Tag by commit. Never reuse a tag.
